R466.note: sqlite3 ? placeholder with (term,) tuple closes the injection; return shape and error behaviour unchanged.

R467.note: mysql2 pool.query(sql, [userId]) placeholder binding closes the vector; same columns, filter, and error handling.

R468.note: SqlCommand with @Region parameter fed to SqlDataAdapter(command) is the right shape; the NVarChar(100) size would silently truncate a region over 100 chars, which no realistic region value hits.

R469.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus external-entity/DTD/XInclude/access-external settings applied before newDocumentBuilder close XXE; DOCTYPE rejection is stated and is the standard fix.

R470.note: Magic-byte verification after write plus extension derived from the verified type closes the spoofed-mimetype/extension gap; the normalised extension in the returned URL (e.g. .jpeg -> .jpg) is stated and blocks no legitimate upload.

R471.note: snprintf bounded by sizeof(display_name) closes the overflow, but it silently truncates oversized names into a different badge value, which the stated contract says must be rejected or reported; the truncation is at least stated openly.

R472.note: Unsigned index checked against calibrationTable.size() before operator[]; invalid index returns rawReading, mirroring the existing short-message path.

R473.note: preg_replace_callback with a fixed callable map closes both the /e eval and the arbitrary-function-name path, but the five-entry allowlist now throws (uncaught, fatal) for previously working formatters such as ucwords or md5; stated, so 1 not 0.

R474.note: Exact-match-or-dot-boundary comparison closes the sibling-package prefix bypass, but the fix also newly ALLOWS primitive arrays and arrays of report classes that the original filter rejected, widening the accepted set beyond the stated explicit-set contract (stated in the write-up, no gadget risk).

R475.note: requireRole('admin') inserted in the same middleware chain and position as the sibling routes; admins unaffected, non-admins get the existing 403.

R476.note: Template source is now a constant and name is passed as a Jinja2 variable, so payload text is data not template syntax; the resulting autoescaping of name is stated and blocks no legitimate link.

R477.note: RESP multibulk framing with per-argument byte lengths closes CRLF/whitespace injection at the protocol level, but the note encoding silently changes from ASCII (non-ASCII became '?') to UTF-8, altering the stored bytes for any accented or emoji note without saying so.

R478.note: URL-parse plus protocol allowlist closes javascript:/data: hrefs, but the allowlist omits mailto: which the stated contract requires, silently turning valid mailto links into '#', and scheme-less values like example.com/page are now emitted as https://dummy-base.invalid/example.com/page rather than the original relative href - neither change is disclosed.

R479.note: Replacing eval with expr-eval-fork's Parser.evaluate confines input to an arithmetic grammar, which is the endpoint's documented purpose; the new dependency, version, and dropped parenthesis wrapper are all stated.
